description: A complete quadratic-character formula for every nonzero determinant fiber of three-by-three symmetric matrices over odd finite fields with all three diagonal entries prescribed; an exact support-only singular-fiber classification.

scientific_integrity.domain: Every odd prime power, all three fixed diagonal elements, every determinant in the field.
limitations: Dimension greater than three is not classified.
Earlier Hodges (1955) symmetric-matrix exponential-sum literature has a material unresolved priority risk because complete full text was not obtained.
scientific_integrity.proof_status: The displayed formulas are proved by finite-field quadratic-form counting; separate exact integer and finite-field arithmetic is supporting verification.

title: Complete determinant fibers for three-dimensional symmetric matrices with prescribed diagonal
